title: Vibra workspace index
description: The JSON wire form of the @index.v1 document: the resolved declaration, implementation, and reference records of one checked workspace snapshot. Identities are atom spellings without the leading @, and type encodings are canonical VIBON text.

workspaceRevision.description: The revision of the exact immutable project and source bytes indexed.

declarations.description: One record per module and per module-level or nested declaration, sorted by the UTF-8 bytes of id.

implementations.description: One record per impl block, sorted by receiver and then interface.

references.description: One record per resolved written name, sorted by source identity, start, and end.

identity.description: A canonical atom identity without the leading @: unit, module, and declaration path.

source.description: A half-open byte span of one source of the snapshot.

facts.description: The checked facts of a declaration.

signature.description: Canonical VIBON: the checked type of a value, function, or method, the generic parameter list of a type or interface, or void for a module.

errors.description: Canonical VIBON of each error type the result can carry.

applications.description: The identities of the declarations the body applies, sorted and without duplicates.

owner.description: The owning type, interface, or effect root of a nested member, else null.

facts.description: The checked facts, or null for an unavailable or recovered declaration.

text.description: The formatter-normalized source of the declaration.

implementation.description: An impl block. It has no atom identity: receiver and interface together identify it.

receiver.description: Canonical VIBON of the receiver type.

interface.description: Canonical VIBON of the applied interface target.

items.description: A member, identified by contract, interface, and receiver.

to.description: The resolved identity, or null for a name the resolver left to the checker.
